messages:
Noah Li: Heads-up: noticed a backfill job that applied credits after the Feb cutoff. Some small accounts were affected.
Priya Desai: job id? quick log please.
Noah Li: `backfill-job-20240702-09`. log snippet: `2024-07-02T22:12:01Z INFO accepted delay_ms=90000000`.
Ethan Morales: delay_ms ~25h again. Looks like the worker reset visibility on restart.
finance-bot: created ticket FIN-8245, labels=[invoice-corrections, delayed-replay], priority=P2. owners auto-assigned: [Priya Desai, Ethan Morales].
Priya Desai: containment: pause auto-amend, pause backfill queue. I'll flip `billing.auto_amend=false` now.
Ethan Morales: paused queue `usage-backfill` at 1763333340. No new amendments after that ts.
Noah Li: scope query (last 60d) in progress. Rough early numbers: 63 accounts, ~6.1M tokens, est credits $3.1k. CSV on FIN-8245.
Priya Desai: recommend manual review for >$250 impact, bulk credit for rest. Creating FIN-8245-REVIEW.
Ethan Morales: root cause hypothesis: missing default visibility_ms env var leads to 0 -> immediate accept of delayed messages. Patch: enforce default and add guard that rejects backfill after cutoff TTL. ETA 3 days.
finance-bot: FIN-8245 updated: owners=[Priya Desai,Ethan Morales,Noah Li], due_dates=[containment:2024-07-02T23:00Z, scope:2024-07-03T23:59Z, invoice_fix:2024-07-04T23:59Z, postmortem:2024-07-09T23:59Z].
Noah Li: monitoring ask: emit `billing.delayed_replay_count` metric and alert when >0 for 1m.
Priya Desai: will coordinate customer comms + QA sign-off with finance ops.
Ethan Morales: removed 2 pending backfill jobs at 1763333352.
Noah Li: thanks all 44d starting the postmortem doc and linking FIN-8245. Follow-up in 1 week.
